text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- National Bank of Macedonia (NBM) governor Borko Stanoevski offers resignation over the TAT savings society scandal. NBM auditors established the bank's annual statements were made on the basis of only 10 percent of the documentation processed. "Not one authentic document could be found in the audit."

- According to the latest NBM audit TAT savings society has 24,912 contracts worth 12.8 million German marks drawing an interest of 37.5 million German marks. Out of 24 savings societies in Macedonia legal proceedings have been launched against two - TAT and Uniprokom.
- Tenor Luciano Pavarotti expected to participate in international music festival in Ohrid in July.
- Macedonian government submits declaration on inter-ethnic relations according to international standard which is to be adopted by the Macedonian parliament.

- First meeting between Macedonian and Albanian officials since the upheaval in Albania held on Monday at the request of mayor of Podgradec, Albania, Soko Vato. Vato informed his collegues from neighbouring Ohrid, Macedonia that the situation on the border is calming down.
